summary.verdict: PANDEMIC STRESS TEST — the substrate on SARS-CoV-2, zero activity data, NO metabolic mechanism (viral). (A) HOMOLOGY-ANCHORED to a related coronavirus (SARS-CoV-1, the 2003 prior knowledge): the engine recovers 3/3 known targets ['P0DTC2', 'P0DTC9', 'P0DTD1'] — the real mechanism by which SARS-CoV-2 targets were prioritized in weeks — but HONESTLY at '['moderate']' confidence, NOT 'high': with no metabolic model there is only ONE signal (conservation), so the substrate AUTOMATICALLY down-tiers confidence (vs 'high' 3-signal bacterial targets) — honest degradation BY CONSTRUCTION. (B) With only a BACTERIAL reference (no related coronavirus), the virus is phylogenetically ISOLATED (TID3), so the substrate ABSTAINS on 17/17 proteins and recovers 0 — it KNOWS it is out of its depth rather than being confidently wrong. This is the north-star 'any disease -> a query' behaviour on the actual pandemic case: homology-anchored where a relative exists, honestly abstaining where none does, and never over-confident without mechanism. SCOPE: 17-protein viral proteome; targets at polyprotein level; conservation-only (no viral mechanism signal exists); demonstration on validated signals; not wet-lab.
